entities.name: T3413
entities.description: EPS mobility management timer used for paging procedure for EPS services. Timer value is network dependent and affected by ISR activation.

entities.name: T3422
entities.description: EPS mobility management timer with value at will of UE, used in GMM-CONNECTED mode for various UE state transitions.

entities.name: T3450
entities.description: Timer with value of 6 seconds used in EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state for ATTACH and TRACKING AREA UPDATE procedures.

entities.name: T3460
entities.description: Timer with value of 6 seconds used in EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state for AUTHENTICATION and SECURITY MODE procedures.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where common procedures are initiated.

entities.name: Paging procedure for EPS services
entities.description: Network procedure to page UE for EPS services.

entities.name: Implicit Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed when paging procedure is aborted on timer expiry.

entities.name: ISR activated
entities.description: Condition where Idle mode Signalling Reduction is activated, affecting timer values.

relations.description: Paging procedure for EPS services initiates timer T3413
Timer T3413 operates in EMM-REGISTERED state
First expiry of T3413 causes Implicit Detach procedure to be performed
ISR activation affects the actual value of timer T3413
Timer T3450 operates in EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state
Timer T3460 operates in EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state
